info.title: TechShop Omnichannel implemented API
info.description: Session authentication. Fetch /api/v1/csrf using the same cookie; send X-CSRF-TOKEN for mutations. Checkout snapshot uses POST /api/v1/orders/preview. Money is integer VND. Installments are internal demo approvals. Public warranty lookup uses serial; phone is an optional matching proof. Branch filters use configured provinceCode/districtCode values; inStock=true hides empty stores. Order detail includes resumable paymentUrl for its persisted transaction.

get.description: Requires CUSTOMER (owner). Active pickup orders only. Expired unpaid holds return 409. Cache-Control: no-store.

404.description: Unknown, other owner or ineligible order
